label: diffuse token-mixture candidate unit (no clean explanation)
explanation: Active on ~5% of steps in all phases (original 45% of mass, copy 52%, delimiter 3%); never at t=0. Rates rise with sequence length (L=9 carries 39% of mass) and with late original positions (orig_idx 7-8 at 13-19%). Mild token preferences: input 1/k/n/b/e/s/m (about 2x lift), previous input e (3.6x), output m/t/p/i in copy phase (3-3.7x). No single variable or small conjunction explains it: out_tok in {m,t,p,i} F1 0.18; prev_tok==e in original phase F1 0.13; input-token set F1 0.18 (mass recall 0.51); a broad disjunction of token sets over phases reaches mass recall 0.67 but precision only 0.14 (F1 0.23). Top activations occur within runs of consecutive active steps around the end of the original sequence, the delimiter, and the first copy outputs, but this is not specific enough to predict. It appears to be a distributed code over token identity and position.
